cohort: The study included 41,253 very preterm infants born at less than 33 weeks gestational age, admitted to all NICUs in Canada between January 1, 2013, and December 31, 2022.
finding: Network-wide quality improvement initiatives led to a significant and sustained reduction in antimicrobial use among preterm infants born at less than 33 weeks gestational age, both with and without culture-proven sepsis or necrotizing enterocolitis (>= Stage 2).
